value.rationale: The source reports host composition-driven switches between multiple local fitness optima at finite competition. A uniform all-host-mixture theorem establishes a precise singular limit where global selection becomes unique, fixes the selected phenotype, identifies the leading induced mortality and excludes bounded-trait hysteresis. It clarifies a substantive biological mechanism and requires a global analysis of the nonlinear implicit trait fitness, not only a formal prefactor cancellation.
